summary: Catherine Grub Hipp of the Easton area, wife of Gottlieb Hipp; John's 5th-great-grand-aunt.
bio: Catherine Grub was born on 25 November 1755 in Williams Township, Northampton County, Pennsylvania. On 21 January 1777 she married Gottlieb Hipp, and the couple lived around Easton. She died on 19 March 1836 in Northampton County and was buried at St John's Lutheran Church Cemetery, Easton. She was John's 5th-great-grand-aunt.

researchNotes:
Catherine (Grub) Hipp (1755-1836), m. Gottlieb Hipp; lived around Easton.

FamilySearch gives Catharina a birth date of 25 Nov 1755 in Williams Twp, her marriage to Gottlieb Hipp on 21 Jan 1777, and her death on 19 Mar 1836, with burial at St John's Lutheran, Easton ([R4-S1]). Gottlieb Hipp's will is in Northampton Will Book 6 pp.18-19.
